docs.title: GoReady
docs.text: Prepare today. Stay ready tomorrow. GoReady is an offline-first emergency preparedness companion that helps individuals and families organize emergency bags, track supplies, and review important preparedness information.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Manage multiple emergency bags
  • Track supply quantities
  • Monitor expiration dates
  • Store emergency information
  • Works offline
  • Local notification reminders

docs.title: Disclaimer
docs.text:
GoReady provides general preparedness information and organizational tools for reference purposes only.

Preparedness recommendations, emergency guidance, and checklist content may not be suitable for every situation, region, household, or medical condition.

Users should evaluate their own needs and follow guidance from local authorities, emergency services, healthcare professionals, or other qualified organizations when appropriate.

GoReady is not a medical, rescue, or emergency response service.

docs.title: Privacy Policy
docs.text:
GoReady Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 15, 2026

  1. Introduction

GoReady (“the App”) is designed to help users manage emergency preparedness information, disaster supply lists, and related emergency reference data.

We value your privacy and aim to minimize data collection whenever possible.

  1. Information Stored by the App

The App may store information entered by the user, including:

  • Emergency preparedness bag information
  • Item names, quantities, notes, brands, purchase dates, purchase sources, prices, and warranty periods
  • Emergency contact information
  • Emergency card information, such as:
  • Name
  • Birthday
  • Phone number
  • Blood type
  • Allergy information
  • Medication notes
  • Chronic condition notes
  • Organization or unit information
  • Emergency gathering location
  • User-created labels and tag names related to preparedness items
  • User-selected images related to preparedness bags, items, or emergency cards

Most data is stored locally on the user's device.

  1. Local Storage

Most user data is stored locally on the user’s device.

At this time, GoReady does not provide automatic cloud synchronization for emergency card information or preparedness data.

  1. Data Sharing

GoReady does not sell user data.

GoReady does not share personal emergency card information with third parties unless the user explicitly initiates a future sharing feature.

If sharing features are introduced in future versions, users will be informed before any data is shared.

  1. Analytics and Error Monitoring

The App may use third-party services for application stability and error monitoring, such as crash reporting tools.

We aim to avoid sending sensitive emergency card information, including medical-related notes, through these monitoring systems.

  1. Notifications

GoReady may request permission to send notifications related to preparedness reminders, such as item expiration reminders.

Notification permissions can be managed through the device settings.

  1. User Control and Data Deletion

Users may edit or delete their data directly within the App at any time.

Removing the App from the device may also remove locally stored App data, depending on the operating system behavior.

  1. Children’s Privacy

GoReady is not directed toward children under the age required by applicable laws for independent consent.

  1. Changes to This Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time.

Any updates will be reflected by revising the “Last updated” date above.

  1. Contact

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, you may contact:

GoReady Support Email: rowan.li.tw@gmail.com

docs.title: 免責聲明
docs.text:
GoReady 提供的一般防災資訊與管理工具僅供參考使用。

防災建議、緊急應變指引與檢查清單內容，可能不適用於所有情況、地區、家庭環境或醫療狀況。

使用者應依自身需求進行評估，並在適當情況下遵循當地政府機關、緊急救援單位、醫療專業人員或其他專業機構之指引。

GoReady 並非醫療、救援或緊急應變服務。

docs.title: 隱私權政策
docs.text:
GoReady 隱私權政策

最後更新日期：2026 年 5 月 15 日

  1. 簡介

GoReady（以下稱「本 App」）旨在協助使用者管理防災準備資訊、防災物資清單，以及相關的緊急應變參考資料。

我們重視您的隱私，並盡可能減少資料蒐集。

  1. App 儲存的資訊

本 App 可能會儲存使用者輸入的資訊，包括：

  • 防災背包資訊
  • 物品名稱、數量、備註、品牌、購買日期、購買來源、價格與保固期限
  • 緊急聯絡人資訊
  • 防災卡資訊，例如：
  • 姓名
  • 生日
  • 電話號碼
  • 血型
  • 過敏資訊
  • 用藥備註
  • 慢性病備註
  • 單位或組織資訊
  • 緊急集合地點
  • 使用者建立的標籤與分類名稱
  • 使用者選擇與防災背包、物品或防災卡相關的圖片

大部分資料皆儲存在使用者的裝置本機中。

  1. 本機儲存

大部分使用者資料皆儲存在使用者的裝置本機。

目前 GoReady 尚未提供防災卡資訊或防災資料的自動雲端同步功能。

  1. 資料分享

GoReady 不會販售使用者資料。

除非使用者主動使用未來可能提供的分享功能，GoReady 不會與第三方分享個人防災卡資訊。

若未來版本新增資料分享功能，將會在任何資料分享前明確告知使用者。

  1. 分析與錯誤監控

本 App 可能使用第三方服務來協助維持應用程式穩定性與錯誤監控，例如當機回報工具。

我們會盡量避免透過這些監控系統傳送敏感的防災卡資訊，包括醫療相關備註內容。

  1. 通知功能

GoReady 可能會請求通知權限，以提供與防災準備相關的提醒，例如物品到期提醒。

使用者可隨時透過裝置設定管理通知權限。

  1. 使用者控制與資料刪除

使用者可隨時於 App 內編輯或刪除自己的資料。

移除本 App 後，儲存在裝置本機中的 App 資料也可能會一併被刪除，實際行為將依作業系統而定。

  1. 兒童隱私

GoReady 並非針對未達適用法律規定可獨立同意年齡之兒童所設計。

  1. 隱私權政策變更

本隱私權政策可能會不定期更新。

任何更新都將透過修改上方「最後更新日期」反映。

  1. 聯絡方式

若您對本隱私權政策有任何疑問，可透過以下方式聯絡：

GoReady Support Email: rowan.li.tw@gmail.com
